page.overview:
Who is Delilah Briarwood?

Lady Delilah Briarwood is a powerful human necromancer from Wildemount, former Archmage of Antiquity for the Cerberus Assembly, and a zealot of Vecna, The Whispered One. She is played in Critical Role by Matthew Mercer and voiced by Grey Griffin in The Legend of Vox Machina.

When Vox Machina first met her, Delilah was a beautiful woman with dark auburn hair, pulled up into a tight braided bun, and blue eyes (lavender in the series). She wore a blue-and-black gown that had a long, billowing skirt which tapered up to be form-fitting at the waist and bodice; the neckline rose nearly to her jaw. She also wore gloves.

During her time as an undead warlock patron she appeared often as a wraith-like entity made of dark and purple energy. After she was sealed inside the Pinion of Service, her appearance was that of a frail woman in a tattered dress chained to an invisible wall, with glowing purple eyes.

Delilah is incredibly cunning and intelligent as well as ruthless, cold, and willful. She is strategically minded, clearly being the mastermind behind the Briarwoods' plans in Whitestone. Despite this ruthless nature, she is genuinely loving and devoted to her husband, willing to do anything to preserve their life together.
